name: 7-hydroxy-DMT
summary: 7-Hydroxy-DMT (7-HO-DMT), also known as 7-hydroxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine family related to dimethyltryptamine (DMT). It is the 7-hydroxy derivative of DMT and is a positional isomer of psilocin (4-HO-DMT), bufotenin (5-HO-DMT), and 6-HO-DMT. The drug shows affinity for serotonin receptors in the rat fundus strip.

pharmacology.text: 7-Hydroxy-DMT (7-HO-DMT), also known as 7-hydroxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the tryptamine family related to dimethyltryptamine (DMT). The drug shows affinity for serotonin receptors in the rat fundus strip.

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of serotonin receptors.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素受體的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素受体的实验室研究。

fact.en: It is a positional isomer of psilocin and of bufotenine: all three have the same atoms, with the hydroxy group at the 4, 5 or 7 position of the ring.
fact.zh: 它是脫磷酸裸蓋菇素與蟾蜍色胺的位置異構物：三者的原子相同，差別只在羥基位於環的第4、第5或第7位。
fact.zhHans: 它是脱磷酸裸盖菇素与蟾蜍色胺的位置异构物：三者的原子相同，差别只在羟基位于环的第4、第5或第7位。
